note: Small rustic campground in virgin pine beside the upper Mississippi River, with sites of 25 to 40 ft (most 30 ft). No staffed office; self-registration and firewood at the entrance kiosk. --Claude
summary: DNR park data + ReserveMN read: $20 confirmed, 28 back-in sites (25-40 ft; 40-ft limit), no electric, vault toilets, campground water Friday before walleye opener-Labor Day, no showers/dump; season 05-14..09-06 (ReserveMN 2027); platform operator -> usedirect. Pin is at the park entrance road ~306 m west of the campground loop. Not waterfront kept. Website -> DNR page; phone 218-328-8984.
